description: [Merchant] Get all execution requests for a specific report type. Returns historical execution records with status and parameters. Production only - not supported in sandbox.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses production private key as default (Data API is production-only).

reportId.description: The report unit ID (path) to get execution history for (e.g., '/processedTransactions')

name: payware_data_get_report_requests
